entities.name: Véronique Tognifodé Mewanou
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Véronique Tognifodé Mewanou is a Beninese politician and educator. She is the current Minister of Social Affairs and Micro-Finance in Benin, having been appointed to the position in early 2021 by the current president of Benin, Patrice Talon. Her term began on 25 May 2021.
